original.question: Mary has 6 jars of sprinkles in her pantry. Each jar of sprinkles can decorate 8 cupcakes. Mary wants to bake enough cupcakes to use up all of her sprinkles. If each pan holds 12 cupcakes, how many pans worth of cupcakes should she bake?
original.answer:
She has enough sprinkles for 6 * 8 = <<6*8=48>>48 cupcakes.
She needs 48 / 12 = <<48/12=4>>4 pans to bake all of the cupcakes.
